tests: AC1: a LICENSE at the root of the local repository is a yes that names it
a path inside the repository is checked at the repository's root
a local repository whose origin is on GitHub gets the SPDX name when GitHub's file is the same
criteria.manual: Ran `swamp workflow run @puddleworks/swamp-extension-checker` (path defaults to .) in this repo, which has LICENSE at its root: it logged "Checking . on local" then "Yes: LICENSE (MIT)." and succeeded.

tests: AC2: no licence file at the root of the local repository is a no
AC3: other extensions and licence files below the root do not count
AC3: a directory named LICENSE is not a licence file
AC3: LICENSE.md, licence.txt and COPYING count and are named
a worktree, whose .git is a file, is a git repository
criteria.manual: Ran `swamp workflow run @puddleworks/swamp-extension-checker --input repo=https://github.com/denoland/deno`: it logged "Checking denoland/deno on github" then "Yes: LICENSE.md (MIT)."

tests: AC4: puddle-works/swamp-for-everything, named, is answered from GitHub
AC4: a named GitHub repository with a licence gets GitHub's SPDX name
AC4: a github.com URL names the same repository
AC4: GitHub's NOASSERTION is no SPDX name, and a licence directory does not count
criteria.manual: The tests fake gh, so I ran it with the real gh signed in. `--input repo=puddle-works/swamp-for-everything` on the form workflow, and the recipe workflow with the same repo, each logged "Checking puddle-works/swamp-for-everything on github" then "No: there is no licence file at the root." (its root has no licence file). `--input repo=https://github.com/denoland/deno` gave "Yes: LICENSE.md (MIT).", so the SPDX name comes through from GitHub. A repository that does not exist failed with "GitHub has no repository acme-nonexistent-zz/nothing-here-zz that gh can see", so real gh 404s are read correctly.

tests: AC5: outside any git repository it says so and asks GitHub nothing
criteria.manual: Ran the form workflow with path set to a new empty scratch directory outside any git repository: it succeeded and logged "<dir> is not in a git repository." The source has no fetch, model or LLM call anywhere.

tests: AC6: a local check changes nothing in the repository
AC6: the recipe calls this extension's run method and reads its result
io.github reads a path with gh api and parses the JSON
io.originUrl gives the origin URL, or null when there is none
criteria.manual: After seven live workflow runs (local, two named repos, a missing repo, a non-git dir, and the recipe), `git status --short` in the repo was identical to before. The only outside calls are `gh api` GETs (no -X/--method) and `git remote get-url origin`, and the source writes no files. Whether puddlerouter skips the model for a matched recipe is router behaviour and is not tested here.
